Question 19
?

In a controlled environment, the temperature T of a hot drink decreases at a rate that's inversely proportional to the cube of the temperature. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the temperature of the drink T?

a
dTdt=−kT3,k>0
b
dTdt=kT3,k>0
c
dTdt=kT3,k>0
d
dTdt=−kT3,k>0
e
dTdt=−kT3,k>0
Submit
